[NSBK.8.1] Registration / load failures use the `-620..-625` backend-ABI range
(`DS_ERR_BACKEND_ABI_VERSION`, `_BAD_MAGIC`, `_BAD_AGGS`, `_NOT_REGISTERED`).
The range is distinct from the
native-Rete loader codes — see [NERR.10.2]. libds registers only its own
backends ([NSBK.2]), so `DS_ERR_BACKEND_ABI_VERSION` (-620),
`DS_ERR_BACKEND_BAD_MAGIC` (-621) and `DS_ERR_BACKEND_BAD_AGGS` (-622) report a
defect in that registration, which fails engine construction ([ISBK.1.7],
[ISBK.3]); -620 also reaches an integrator through the cache callbacks
([NSTG.2.4]). -624 and -625 are reserved: libds loads no backend from a shared
object ([NERR.10.2]).
